title: UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Main Exam Fee Payment 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC)
postName: Scientific Assistant and Lab Assistant Main Examination - Advt. No. 15-Exam/2026
vacancyDetails: Scientific Assistant: 134; Scientific Assistant Special Selection: 13; Lab Assistant: 56; Lab Assistant Special Selection: 05
qualification: UPSSSC PET 2025 qualified with a valid non-zero score and the relevant B.Sc., B.Tech or NIELIT qualification as prescribed in the notification
ageLimit: 21 to 40 years as on 01/07/2026; age relaxation as per UPSSSC rules
applicationFee: Main examination fee: Rs. 25 for all categories; pay through the official UPSSSC portal
documentsRequired: PET 2025 registration details, UPSSSC OTR credentials, photo ID and application details
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open the Scientific Assistant / Lab Assistant Main Examination fee payment link
3. Log in with the required UPSSSC credentials
4. Pay the Rs. 25 examination fee and save the receipt
5. Download the fee payment notice and check the admit card or exam schedule updates before the examination
shortDescription: UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Main Examination 2026 fee payment update for 208 Scientific Assistant and Lab Assistant posts under Advt. 15-Exam/2026.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has issued the Main Examination fee payment update for Scientific Assistant and Lab Assistant posts under Advt. No. 15-Exam/2026.

The recruitment covers 208 posts. Eligible PET-2025 candidates should pay the Rs. 25 main examination fee through the official UPSSSC portal and keep the payment receipt safe.

Important information

  • Application window: 27 July 2026 to 24 August 2026
  • Eligibility result available: 27 August 2026
  • Main examination date: As per UPSSSC schedule
  • Exam city and admit card: Before the examination

Use the official fee payment, notice and eligibility result links below. Check UPSSSC for the final examination schedule and admit card release.

importantDates.examDate: Main examination date to be announced by UPSSSC
